name: Yield Yak
rootCause: According to security firm Blockaid, Yield Yak suffered a frontend attack. Its subdomain vote.yieldyak.com was injected with Eleven Drainer malicious code, posing risks of asset theft upon access. This mirrors a similar frontend attack previously experienced by Gitcoin.
